title: Amazon Offers Discount on Apple TV+ for Prime Members
summary: Amazon has reduced the price of Apple TV+ through its Prime Video service, offering a discount of over 50% off the standard subscription fee. The move aims to attract more subscribers and increase revenue. This change is part of Amazon's efforts to expand its streaming services and compete with other major players in the market.
summary_points: Amazon has cut the price of Apple TV+ through Prime Video to $5.99 a month for two months.
The discount offers more than 50% off the standard subscription fee.
This change is part of Amazon's efforts to expand its streaming services and compete with other major players in the market.
Amazon has reduced the price of Apple TV+ through Prime Video, aiming to attract more subscribers and increase revenue.
The move follows Amazon's strategy to offer competitive pricing and promotions to its customers.
